meta.quotes: arrays hold one value per minute; value i is the candle ENDING at window[0] + (i+1)*60. bid/ask = best YES quote observed at candle end; last/lo/hi = trades inside the minute (null = none). bid/ask are the book as observed (bid 0 or ask 1 = one-sided, no two-sided quote); null = no candle that minute (the last observed book stands) or after trading stops
meta.marks: close_ts = contract close_time (trading stops; Kalshi rules allow accelerated determination on a consensus of media projections); settle_ts = settlement_ts. Neither is a media call time
meta.price: all prices are for the DEMOCRATIC contract's YES side; nothing is blended with the Republican contract
meta.inputs: Midterm_markets raw/candles_1m_linked + catalog; kalsi_palantir stream metadata and chat timing (no text)
meta.streams: clock: chat-verified = YouTube chat send times agree with start + video offset within 60 s; unverified = no chat on disk to check; upload = not a live stream, start is the upload time. chat_minus_start_s is measured and NOT applied: transcripts are placed at start + video offset
